name: head_cap Pi seat moved 4.6 mm back (candidate)
status: Candidate only. Not released, not sliced, not zipped. The V1.6 release folder is untouched.
problem: Step cap-on: the plugged 2x20 GPIO crimp housing on the Pi header sweeps through camera_clamp_screw_3, camera_retainer, camera_board and face_panel while the populated cap is lowered straight down.

change.rails: Both Pi side rails (final-integration-20261009/pi-roof-side-rail-0.stl and -1.stl) removed and re-added translated by [-4.6, 0, 0], clipped 0.1 mm under the outer roof as union_cap.py does.
change.trim: Only the +y rail is trimmed to x >= 52.8 (robot frame); jaw_support ends at x 52.3 in that y band. The -y rail needs no trim.
change.bossesRemoved: The two former OpenRB front roof bosses (controller-roof-boss-0 and -2, y about +-10, x 57.3 to 62.6) are removed. guide/content/fasteners.json lists them as unassigned holes; left in place they would overlap the moved Pi PCB by 9.2 mm3 each.
change.unchanged: Everything outside the six edit boxes; XOR volume outside them 6.4e-13 mm3. The rear cable notch, tie hood, speaker and amplifier posts, rim and rear bosses are identical.

worldToStlFrame.how: Kabsch fit of guide/print/world/head_cap.stl vertices to guide/print/stl/head_cap.stl vertices (88776 each)

head_cap-pi-shift-world.stl.frame: Robot frame (mm, x forward, y left, z up); same frame as guide/print/world/head_cap.stl.

head_cap-pi-shift-stlframe.stl.frame: Release source frame; drop-in replacement for guide/print/stl/head_cap.stl. The V1.6 release places it with the unchanged sourceToPrint below.

head_cap-pi-shift-print.stl.frame: Flat print pose of the V1.6 release (sourceToPrint applied to the source-frame file). Same bounds and flat contact as the released cap.

pi-positive-y-upper-hole-support-blocker.frame: The Bambu non-printing support blocker for the +y upper Pi pilot (14-HEAD-TRIAL functional review), moved with the rail. It is in the same frame as the V1.6 blocker file, which the pilot-mouth test places in the release source frame.

requiredCompanionChanges: Fastener E-pi-02 (+y lower Pi screw): M2x4 instead of M2x6. With the trim, an M2x6 tip leaves the rail and sweeps 10.03 mm3 into jaw_support during cap-on (M2x5: 0.28 mm3); M2x4 is clear and engages 2.46 mm (rail material 2.9 to 3.24 mm on that axis). E-pi-01, -03 and -04 keep M2x6 with 4.4 mm of material. The Pi step text in guide/content/steps.py (four M2 x 6) must change to three M2 x 6 and one M2 x 4 at the +y lower corner.
Guide data: move the Pi group, the GPIO housing envelopes and the cable ends at the header by [-4.6, 0, 0]; update fastener seats E-pi-01..04 by the same vector.
routes.json bundle_head: re-route the last segment. With only the end moved, the drawn centreline passes 0.9 mm from the moved +y rail (V1.6: 3.37 mm minimum, at the notch).
routes.json head_csi: path grows by about 1.0 mm (straight 28.44 to 29.44 mm); the 200 mm ribbon covers it.
Slicing: re-slice both machines, use the shifted Pi support blocker for Bambu and review the +y upper pilot again.
